verdict.rationale: Workable documents sourcing through a searchable passive-candidate database, AI-recommended candidates from a pool of 400 million profiles, and a Workable Agent that sources and screens candidates. That covers finding prospects, but the evidence never shows the talent-CRM layer the story centers on. Missing for 10: saved talent pools of prospects, personalized email sequences, open/reply tracking, nurture campaigns for future roles, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
